saw_lines: Buyers of a home gym buy once and live with it for years, so they compare build quality and fit first.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides to stay or scroll past.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 17 ads mention it. Open three new ads with that discount in line one and print it on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 17 ads mention it or any offer, so new buyers have no reason to act. Open three new ads with that discount in line one and print it on the creative.

None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and open three new ads with it.

Your 17 copy ads open with 13 different stories, and the biggest, the athletes trust line, leads only 2. Nothing repeats enough to build a clear message. Build six new ads from the ATHX rig install and the Danny Rae line.

30 of your ads have stayed live 60 days or more, so the format and message already work. Build three more variations of your oldest one, each with a new opening line and a shorter body, and run them beside it.

ads_1: Install stories and HYROX openers, each with the first order discount on the creative
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
